summary: The complete AS-M004 revision-2 dirty delivery has sufficient evidence for an accepted independent whole-mission review. P04 resolves final-r1's one high qualification blocker: the observer now walks all task child lists recursively, deduplicates process IDs, and includes the actual nonleader-thread Git children in the consuming resource protocol. I independently reran both measurement tests with an external OS parentage observation; both passed. Cumulative production, dependency, failure, quota, API/design and complete demonstration evidence remains applicable after verified source hashes. No remaining concrete defect or architecture blocker was identified. This result does not change mission state, commit, publish, integrate or close the mission.

This assessment covers the source-hashed dirty tree, not implementation in baseline HEAD; eventual committed-head GitHub CI and publication remain separate.

contractAssessment.criterion: Synchronous source retention and fresh-process recovery after loss of origins
contractAssessment.detail: save_capture consumes the real immutable workspace::Capture without recapture or configuration re-resolution. One SQLite transaction retains comparison selection/resolved commit, generations, exact configuration bytes/provenance, ordered change membership and before/after/context bytes, roles, Git blob/mode identities. A fresh-process read after deleting the whole repository compares the full retained projection and bound range with the captured input. Tests retain deletion versus present empty bytes, empty captures and independent repeated occurrence IDs. Capture-only records add no fictitious analyzer/model/policy success.

One domain-separated, length/presence-encoded SHA-256 implementation covers the header, counts, ordinals, membership, provenance and actual bytes at save/read in a single read snapshot. Missing/extra/duplicate membership and modified source/configuration/provenance are rejected before returning a retained result. Ranges bind path, role and generation before slicing. AUTOINCREMENT occurrence IDs remain separate from equal content/generations; no dedup merges provenance. This is corruption detection, not a keyed authenticity guarantee; whole-row deletion is NotFound.

Schema v1 DDL and user_version are in one transaction. The conflicting-view test proves failed initialization leaves version zero and no partial store tables. Unchanged reopen and refusal of version 2, unrelated database, malformed bytes and unavailable parent are covered. verify checks the three table names and integrity column, not a complete schema fingerprint; incompatible later reads/writes still return explicit errors. There is no actually shipped earlier schema, so no speculative migration framework is required.

contractAssessment.criterion: Complete-or-absent writes, durability and honest acknowledgement outcomes
contractAssessment.detail: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, all inserts and one commit own the capture. WAL and synchronous FULL are set and verified. Installed rusqlite source confirms default rollback on transaction drop and explicit COMMIT. Real triggers, lock-wait termination, WAL-write EIO, a kill inside the WAL sync call after frames are written, and postcommit/preack termination cover distinct failures. Prior acknowledged bytes survive; an interrupted attempt is complete or absent. The during-commit case legitimately recovered complete from OS-cached frames and does not prove physical power-loss durability. CommittedUnmeasured names the committed ID when postcommit footprint measurement fails; measured overshoot returns the committed ID and over_limit without deleting data. A general I/O/commit error does not establish absence or exactly-once retry.

The warning uses overflow-safe u128 integer arithmetic. Admission adds actual DB/WAL/SHM/journal lengths to a checked reservation for real row/payload lists, WAL frame overhead, checkpoint duplication and current WAL backlog. BEGIN IMMEDIATE holds writer ownership through save, so outstanding required capacity has no separate ledger or crash-leaked reservation. Real tests cover required-1 refusal/required admission, two competing processes admitting only one capture, old-record reads under a lower budget and bounded busy errors. This synchronous capture ends within its transaction and needs no separate future-work terminal-status lifecycle or background queue. The constants are conservative measured allowances, not a hard filesystem quota, disk-block reservation or proof for arbitrary SQLite settings.

contractAssessment.criterion: Effective database identity and accounting assumptions
contractAssessment.detail: SQLite opens the supplied path, then OS canonicalization binds accounting to the existing effective database path. This replaces the prior custom resolver. Held-reader file/directory aliases, new files through aliased parents and dangling final symlinks exercise actual DB/WAL paths, not a no-reader counterexample that checkpoints away the defect. Installed bundled Unix VFS source confirms symlink component resolution. Page size is read; the qualified bundled default uses zero reserved page bytes and default auto-checkpoint behavior. The formula computes actual rows/byte lengths and does not infer retained source count from inventory count. Changed SQLite settings/builds, path replacement, other files or physical allocated blocks are not silently qualified.

contractAssessment.criterion: Real storage, buffers, synchronous persistence cost and owned-process observations
contractAssessment.detail: The current P04 protocol renews one/five-file capture/save/read, separate fresh open/reopen and synchronous save cost, metadata-heavy, 1 MiB, 8 MiB and held-reader cases. Raw nearest-rank percentile arithmetic was checked. Both current measurement tests were independently rerun with external OS parentage observation. The corrected combined journeys include the real Git child scope, while per-process RSS is counted once. P03 capture-journey tree-memory claims are superseded and are not current proof. The measurements include harness/prepared retained inputs and are not an isolated allocator-cost or future ADR-007 budget result.

One records module hides SQLite, schema, transaction/admission ownership, errors and reconstruction behind open/save/read/usage. It reuses workspace/config types and generation owners without new pass-through service layers, crate, repository interface, universal result model, external blob publication protocol or queue lifecycle. Borrowed digest views and owned stored rows serve different lifetimes while keeping the integrity algorithm authoritative once. The long linear save/read methods follow cohesive row construction and recovery; extracting shallow layers would expose more concepts. P04's held-child guard, kernel-known IDs, shared lock and membership probe have concrete qualification purposes; its additional size alone is not a smell finding.

The actual Cargo delta adds exact rusqlite 0.41.1 with defaults disabled and bundled SQLite, plus nine locked additions without unrelated upgrades; tests use the same real binding. Installed binding and SQLite build/source were inspected. The retained live-registry/Socket policy proof covers the resolved additions and complete restored graph. No registry freshness, latest-version recommendation or dependency change was made in this review. The import-only initial RED and pre-age-check downloads remain historical deviations with only their specific user exception; they are not relabelled compliant and do not waive subsequent behavioral RED. Later integrity, admission, alias and P04 regression logs preserve intended behavior failures.

limits: The corrected observer covers the actual process tree scope at sampled observations; it does not capture every child or instantaneous peak. A 1 ms sleep plus observer work can miss transient children, task reparenting/exits and higher peaks. PID reuse is not excluded. /proc disappearance is skipped; this is not a qualified general-purpose observer for restricted/unavailable procfs. Real known-child and normal-journey probes on this host establish the relevant coverage.

Per-process VmRSS can count shared pages more than once and the kernel RSS itself is approximate. The tree sum is not unique physical memory. Both harness and prepared capture buffers are included, and it is not an isolated product-memory delta.

Storage peaks are sampled logical DB and auxiliary file lengths, not allocated filesystem blocks or a formal all-instant peak bound. Most current peaks equal final retained size; the longer historical checkpoint observations and near-boundary tests support the engineering allowance without proving a hard quota.
One warm-cache Linux host, debug build, declared fixtures, 20/30-observation latency series and single peak runs provide local evidence, not tail-confidence or future ADR-007 B1-B4 acceptance.

SQLite WAL/FULL guarantees depend on the real VFS/filesystem/device honoring writes and synchronization. Process-kill/EIO fixtures establish recovery and caller-visible outcomes at those seams, not physical durability certification.

report:
APPROVE; architecture CLEAR; critical 0, high 0, medium 0, low 0. No remaining concrete defect was identified in the complete approved AS-M004 revision-2 delivery. The previous high blocker is resolved: the resource protocol's authoritative observer enumerates all task child lists recursively and deduplicates process PIDs before summing RSS. Its actual consuming regression and all renewed resource journeys pass. Independent OS observation confirmed the same Git children reported by the current normal capture journeys under nonleader TID 2522170 while the leader child list was empty. The renewed sampled combined tree RSS is approximately 33.8 MB for one/five files and 52.4 MB for eight 1 MiB files in this diagnostic run; these are local sampled figures with the detailed limits above, not future product-budget claims.

The whole review includes synchronous capture/save/read after deleting origins, integrity and occurrence identity, schema compatibility/atomic creation, complete-or-absent writes and acknowledgement ambiguity, postcommit measurement/overshoot truth, warning/admission/reservations/concurrent writers, actual effective database paths, database/auxiliary and buffer costs, dependency/process evidence, module/API complexity and the complete nonvisual demonstration. Unchanged runtime proof is reused by verified hashes; the prior rejected verdict is never treated as acceptance. The required stabilized full CI was executed by P04 and examined here; this reviewer reran only affected measurement/Clippy and read-only format checks. Source is implemented and locally tested but still uncommitted. The accepted independent result is for Firstmate to examine and register; it does not itself accept/close the mission or authorize publication/integration.
